sentences.en: And that's the sort of danger here.

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the House overwhelmingly passed a landmark housing bill,
sentences.zh: 周二，众议院以压倒性多数通过了一项具有里程碑意义的住房法案，

sentences.en: clearing the way for President Trump to sign the most significant piece of housing legislation in more than three decades.
sentences.zh: 为特朗普总统签署三十多年来最重要的住房立法扫清了障碍。

sentences.en: The measure aims to tackle the housing crisis by boosting supply in an effort to deal with the acute shortage of homes in America.
sentences.zh: 该法案旨在通过增加供应来应对住房危机，以解决美国住房严重短缺的问题。

sentences.en: The Senate already passed its version of the same bill, and a White House official said that Trump was expected to sign it into law on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 参议院此前已通过了该法案的参议院版本，白宫官员表示，预计特朗普将于周三签署使其成为法律。

sentences.en: And the Senate adopted a resolution instructing President Trump to end the war in Iran or seek congressional authorization to keep it going.
sentences.zh: 此外，参议院还通过了一项决议，要求特朗普总统结束在伊朗的战争，或寻求国会授权以继续进行。

sentences.en: Trump never sought approval from Congress for the war, and this was the most significant bipartisan rebuke of the conflict yet.
sentences.zh: 特朗普此前从未就这场战争寻求国会批准，这是迄今为止两党对该冲突最严厉的谴责。

sentences.en: The resolution doesn't have the force of law, but it did represent a symbolically important break with the president by some in the GOP.
sentences.zh: 该决议虽不具备法律效力，但它代表了共和党内部一些人与总统之间在象征意义上的重要决裂。

sentences.en: The measure passed 50 to 48, with four Republicans joining Democrats in favor.
sentences.zh: 该法案以50票对48票获得通过，有四名共和党人加入民主党阵营投了赞成票。
